style: soft 3D cartoon, top-down, warm and friendly
themeWhy: keys in the tan of the earth path, a berry Enter as the treat of the same park

images.prompt: One plump, compact reddish-brown garden ant seen from directly above with its head at the top: a large round head, a short thick glossy oval body, short stubby legs bent close against its sides and two short antennae curving forward, the whole ant filling a tight, rounded outline.
images.why: Opening 'the ant at a corner' and phase 2 'walks the ant round the three sides': the walker, same picture as Edge Walker

images.prompt: One straight length of twisted golden-tan jute rope, thick and fibrous, lying flat with a small knot at each end.
images.why: Stage 'the perimeter string lies straight at y 600, 820 long, vermilion' and Halve folds it: the string, tinted vermilion in code

images.prompt: A straight stretch of dusty tan packed-earth path, flat and even, with a few tiny pebbles.
images.why: Phase 4 'a square pond path with each side labelled 3.4 m': the path laid along each of the four sides, the lap walked on it
